An introduction to this system of ideas.

The notes began as an experimental "zettelkasten" [[89]] with notes on just about every topic worth writing down. Eventually, it formed a Topology of ideas; that's when the Zettelkasten [[89]] aspect started synergizing with natural Human conversational-styled note-taking. Not merely "Atomic-notes" in the isolated sense; but Atomic-ideas interwoven within a larger narrative. This meant the ideas themselves became part of the natural conversation

The idea of "integers" [[150]] arised naturally; each file was simply assigned an incremental [[151]] integer


This work serves as an experimental "zettelkasten"-inspired knowledge base, researching methods for knowledge sytsems.

Once an experimental branch of the "biblioteca" project [^1], this project has grown into an organic biota of ideas.

A zettelkasten-based + graph + hierarchy + narrative. This system is entirely experimental and graph-driven. 

The shape of knowledge naturally forms a manifold strucutre, which we know as "Topology." [[145]] This topology is non-arbitrary; The organic arrangement of the knowledge in this system, is laid out in story-form, as-it-is-captured. This reveals the Function of Natural Language [[]]; as the Natural form [[]] of Navigation [[]] for Human Life; the "Collapsed Graph." [[100]]
